title: Repayment difficulty, restructuring and insurance - support procedure
content: The synthetic workflow routes hardship or coverage questions to a demo agent with the relevant product context. Explain the issue without sensitive documents, and seek the lender or insurer's formal terms before relying on any proposed option.
